A few things to know

Clear answers.
No fine-print maze.

Something else on your mind?
We’re here to help ↗

Do I have to stop drinking completely?

Drytally is a diary, not a prescribed programme. You can use it to understand your drinking, cut back or record alcohol-free days. Health decisions belong with you and a qualified professional.

What is free, and what is Pro?

Try the app for 24 continuous hours after first agreement acceptance. Each cold app launch requires online preview verification; a verified running session can count down offline. Afterwards, today’s existing content is read-only only when today’s date can be verified; logging, editing, history and other features require valid access. No automatic charge occurs when the preview ends. Weekly and Lifetime purchases are optional; Apple shows the actual price and terms.

Does it sync my diary to the cloud?

Your diary works locally. Optional iCloud history sync is off by default and requires valid access, a supported build and your Apple account. Changes take effect after restarting the app. Photos stay on this device; iCloud history is not a photo backup. The operator-hosted purchase backend does not receive diary entries.

Do I need to connect Apple Health?

No. Health writing is optional and controlled by your permission. You can keep a local diary without enabling it, and change access later in iOS settings.

Is Drytally medical advice?

No. It is a personal record-keeping tool, not a medical device, treatment programme or emergency service. It does not determine whether alcohol use is safe or promise a health outcome.

How can I get support or make a privacy request?

Visit Contact us or email erchen735@gmail.com. For privacy requests, use “Privacy request” as the subject. Please send only information relevant to your question.
